notes: Windows 0.1-dev.24 - the relay fix. The last two-device run had the co-host monitor ON TIME but garbled: the relay's voice sender was cutting every encoded voice packet into small chunks and sending each chunk as its own packet, and a compressed packet cannot be cut up - about half of everything the hub forwarded failed to decode. Each packet now travels whole, exactly as it came off the encoder, and the encoder is capped at one 20 ms frame per packet. A packet that will not decode is now dropped, counted, and logged once instead of killing the connection. A stopping hub now withdraws its registration (the server half is deployed alongside this build; against an older server the withdrawal is refused before anything is written), and a device refuses to dial a hub record that names itself. Monitor only arrives on Windows (Handoff menu, Client role, on by default, per device, never synced). In Client mode the Play Deck follows the hub's playlist and stands on its item, display only; take the air and your deck starts that playlist at that item. Options now shows ONE connection button - Disconnect while connected, Connect while not; which button exists IS the state. Mixer mode rides along from dev.23, still untested on real mixers. Known limits: the proof of the clean monitor is the next two-device run.
